fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A weapon strike usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: it deals 22 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Signal
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash in a full circle that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. On a hit, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Lead
fusions.desc: Slips a hound off the lead for 15 seconds. It bites an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Heel
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
